title: PixelPatrol Table Row
description: One row in a PixelPatrol table. Fixed columns are in properties; per-axis families (size_*, dim_*, pixel_size_*) are in patternProperties.

common_base.description: Name of the longest path prefix shared by all import bases.

depth.description: Depth of the path below the imported base directory.

file_extension.description: Lower-cased file extension without the leading dot.

imported_path.description: Path of the import base (the -p path or base directory) under which this file was found, relative to the project base directory ('.' when no -p paths were specified).

imported_path_short.description: Shortened, disambiguated label for the import base (only when several -p paths were used).

modification_date.description: Last modification timestamp of the file.

name.description: File or folder name, including extension.

path.description: Path of the file (or folder), relative to the project base directory.

size_bytes.description: Size on disk in bytes (aggregated for folders).

type.description: Row kind: 'file', 'folder', or 'sub_file' (a sub-image inside a container).

channel_names.description: Names of the image channels, if available.

child_id.description: Identifier of a sub-image within a container file (null for single-image files).

dim_names.description: Human-readable names of the image axes.

dim_order.description: Axis order of the image, e.g. 'TCZYX'.

dtype.description: Pixel data type of the source image (e.g. 'uint8', 'float32').

h5_attributes.description: Raw HDF5 attributes of the dataset, merged with file root attributes.

h5_dataset_path.description: Path of the dataset within the HDF5 file.

zarr_attributes.description: Raw key-value attributes stored in the Zarr/OME-Zarr group metadata.

ndim.description: Number of image dimensions, derived from dim_order.

num_pixels.description: Number of pixels in this row's spatial extent (full image at obs_level=0, slice at higher levels).

obs_level.description: Aggregation level of the row: 0 is the whole-image summary; higher levels are per-dimension breakdowns.

bright_clipping_fraction.description: Fraction of pixels at the dtype's maximum representable value (integer types only; NaN for float). Detects sensor saturation at the dtype ceiling.

dark_clipping_fraction.description: Fraction of pixels at the dtype's minimum representable value (0 for unsigned integers; NaN for float). Detects underexposure, background, and nodata at the dark end.

finite_pixel_count.description: Number of finite (non-NaN/Inf) pixels contributing to the statistics.

histogram_counts.description: Per-bin pixel counts over the histogram value range (fixed number of bins; integer data uses one-level-wide bins).

histogram_max.description: Upper bound of the histogram's value range.

histogram_min.description: Lower bound of the histogram's value range.

histogram_nan_count.description: Number of NaN pixels excluded from the histogram.

laplacian_variance.description: High-frequency content measure. Blur and heavy compression push values down; sharpness, noise, and fine texture push values up. A smooth, featureless scene will score low regardless of focus quality. Clipped pixels inflate the score.

max_intensity.description: Maximum pixel intensity over the covered extent (ignoring NaNs).

mean_intensity.description: Pixel-count-weighted mean intensity over the covered extent.

min_intensity.description: Minimum pixel intensity over the covered extent (ignoring NaNs).

nan_fraction.description: Fraction of pixels excluded as NaN.

spectral_slope.description: Log-log slope of the radially averaged power spectrum, fit over the mid-frequency band (5–40% of Nyquist). Typical range: −2 to −4. Closer to 0 indicates noise or uniform content. More negative values indicate blur or stronger low-frequency dominance.

std_intensity.description: Pooled standard deviation of intensity over the covered extent.

thumbnail_dtype.description: Original pixel dtype of the source image the thumbnail was built from.

thumbnail_norm_max.description: Upper intensity bound used to normalize the thumbnail.

thumbnail_norm_min.description: Lower intensity bound used to normalize the thumbnail.

^parent\\d+$.description: Name of one directory level of the containing directory, counted from the top: parent0 is the first directory below the base directory, parent1 the one below that; null when the file is not that deep.
^parent\\d+$.title: parent<N>

^pixel_size_[A-Za-z]$.description: Physical pixel size along the given axis, in the image's spatial unit.
^pixel_size_[A-Za-z]$.title: pixel_size_<axis>

^size_[A-Za-z]$.description: Extent (number of elements) of this row along the given axis.
^size_[A-Za-z]$.title: size_<axis>

^dim_[A-Za-z]+$.description: Coordinate of this row along the given axis (e.g. dim_z = Z index); null when the row spans the whole axis.
^dim_[A-Za-z]+$.title: dim_<axis>
